raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #42684.

With `SGLANG_DISAGG_STAGING_BUFFER=1` on non-MLA models, both `prefill.py` and `decode.py` call

```python
kv_manager.set_kv_buffer_tensors(k_buffers, v_buffers, page_size, slot_layer_ids=...)
```

unconditionally. `MooncakeKVManager` accepts the `slot_layer_ids` kwarg, but `NixlKVManager` never got it, so picking the NIXL backend in staging mode kills the kv manager with

```
TypeError: NixlKVManager.set_kv_buffer_tensors() got an unexpected keyword argument 'slot_layer_ids'
```

during init and the server never comes up.

## Modifications

`NixlKVManager.set_kv_buffer_tensors` now takes `slot_layer_ids` and stashes it in `kv_buffer_tensors`, matching the Mooncake signature. This is parity only: the NIXL staged gather walks the registered buffers in list order and nothing reads the mapping back. The same scoped fix is currently carried inside the larger #40909 and #40861; this PR lands it on its own so staging mode works on main without waiting for those.

Added two unit tests to `TestNixlStaging` covering the kwarg and its default.

## Accuracy Tests

No model output changes; disaggregation metadata path only.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No hot path impact.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). (`ruff check --select=F401,F821,F823,UP037` and `ruff format --check` both pass on the touched files)
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). The two new cases live in `TestNixlStaging` (`base-a-test-cpu`); I do not have NIXL hardware here, so the staging transfer paths themselves are covered by CI, as before.
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (N/A, no user-facing config change)
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (N/A, see above)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

detail.title: [Bugfix][PD] Accept slot_layer_ids in NixlKVManager.set_kv_buffer_tensors

files.patch:
@@ -621,15 +621,25 @@ def _register_staging_memory(self, ptr: int, size: int):
                 f"(ptr=0x{ptr:x}, size={size})"
             )
 
-    def set_kv_buffer_tensors(self, k_buffers: list, v_buffers: list, page_size: int):
+    def set_kv_buffer_tensors(
+        self,
+        k_buffers: list,
+        v_buffers: list,
+        page_size: int,
+        slot_layer_ids: Optional[List[int]] = None,
+    ):
         # NOTE: matches mooncake behavior -- staging buffers are now
         # created in __init__ (per-worker), independent of the kv
         # tensors. This setter only stashes the tensor metadata used by
-        # send_kvcache_staged().
+        # send_kvcache_staged(). slot_layer_ids is accepted for signature
+        # parity with MooncakeKVManager (prefill.py/decode.py pass it
+        # unconditionally); the NIXL staged gather walks the buffers in
+        # list order, so nothing reads it back.
         self.kv_buffer_tensors = {
             "k_buffers": k_buffers,
             "v_buffers": v_buffers,
             "page_size": page_size,
+            "slot_layer_ids": list(slot_layer_ids or []),
         }
 
     def register_staging_room_bootstrap(self, room, bootstrap_infos, receiver):

@@ -1107,6 +1107,29 @@ def _make_manager(self, agent=None):
         mgr.server_args = SimpleNamespace(chunked_prefill_size=4)
         return mgr
 
+    def test_set_kv_buffer_tensors_accepts_slot_layer_ids(self):
+        # prefill.py/decode.py pass slot_layer_ids= unconditionally under
+        # SGLANG_DISAGG_STAGING_BUFFER on non-MLA models; the setter must
+        # accept it or kv_manager init dies with TypeError (#42684).
+        mgr = self._make_manager()
+        mgr.set_kv_buffer_tensors(
+            ["k0", "k1"], ["v0", "v1"], 2, slot_layer_ids=[0, 1, 0, 1]
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            mgr.kv_buffer_tensors,
+            {
+                "k_buffers": ["k0", "k1"],
+                "v_buffers": ["v0", "v1"],
+                "page_size": 2,
+                "slot_layer_ids": [0, 1, 0, 1],
+            },
+        )
+
+    def test_set_kv_buffer_tensors_slot_layer_ids_default_empty(self):
+        mgr = self._make_manager()
+        mgr.set_kv_buffer_tensors(["k0"], ["v0"], 1)
+        self.assertEqual(mgr.kv_buffer_tensors["slot_layer_ids"], [])
+
     def test_register_buffer_to_engine_groups_kv_memory_kinds_in_one_pass(self):
         agent = StagingFakeAgent(register_result=["desc"])
         mgr = self._make_manager(agent)
